Monthly reporting gets easier when the data arrives in one place.

Harlow Council uses Brightwell Analytics for monthly energy reports across 14 sites. Each site manager now reviews one report instead of rebuilding a spreadsheet the night before, and the council's energy lead sees every site side by side. [Approved quote from Harlow Council] For facilities managers, that means time back for the decisions behind the numbers: where consumption is rising and which site to visit first.

How many sites does your monthly report cover today? Tell us in the comments.

#Brightwell #EnergyReporting #FacilitiesManagement
